| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Kernel** `kernel` | 1 2 1; 2 4 2; 1 2 1 | Rows of numbers, odd sides up to 15 | The weights, row by row. Separate rows with semicolons or new lines, and numbers with spaces or commas. Both sides must be odd, up to 15. |
| **Normalize** `normalize` | on | On or off | Divide the weights by their sum, so they add up to 1. Skipped when the sum is 0. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Clip to 0 to 255 | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only, Color only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
